name: Enterprise Risk Landscape and Assurance Coverage View
constraints: Risk Landscape is a governed view with immutable snapshots and Assurance Coverage is an explicit-denominator projection; neither remasters risk or control state.
Risk, requirement, obligation, control, assessment, audit, finding, observation and evidence retain separate mastership.
The view pins subjects, jurisdictions, requirement provisions, control catalogue, criteria, taxonomy and cut-off and preserves pending-master markers.
Coverage, compliance, assurance and residual risk use separate denominators and never collapse into one percentage.
Control existence, design, implementation, operation and effectiveness are independent states.
Risk reduction requires a current cited determination, while reliance without determination remains explicit.
Expired conclusions remain visible but cannot ground new acceptance; exception expiry never changes the requirement itself.
Aggregation requires comparable criteria, method, scope, horizon and taxonomy and cannot strip caveats.
holds: WM-XCT-027 control split and relation contracts require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review, crosswalks, source pins and frozen audit remain pending.
